Brand Introduction:
ERGO PURRCH™ is a premium pet lifestyle brand dedicated to creating products that seamlessly blend functionality, sustainability, and design. Our focus is on elevating the bond between cats and their humans through thoughtfully crafted solutions.

Product Description:
Our flagship product is a fully adjustable, desk-mounted cat bed designed to give cats a comfortable spot close to their owners without cluttering valuable workspace. Built from sustainable hardwood and available with a handwoven bed option, it supports up to 45 lbs and mounts securely to surfaces up to 2.75 inches thick.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • Rotates 360° for ultimate flexibility

  • Sleek, premium design that complements any space

  • Built for cats of all sizes, up to 45 lbs

  • Sustainable materials and handcrafted quality

  • Creates a dedicated perch that reduces distractions while working

Payment Terms:
Affiliates earn a 10% commission on the product total (before shipping, taxes, and discounts if applicable). Payouts are issued quarterly, with a minimum threshold of $100 in affiliate commissions. Exceptions for early payouts may be made on a case-by-case basis upon request.

Other Information:

  • We provide creative assets and messaging support.

  • We offer one of the highest commission rates among premium brands.
payout_period: Payouts are issued at the end of each month. If you haven’t reached the minimum threshold of $100 in commissions, your earnings will roll over to the following month and be paid out once the threshold is met.

ERGO PURRCH® Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Welcome to ERGO PURRCH INC.! Thank you for joining our Affiliate Program.


The following terms and conditions (“Terms and Conditions”) apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we,” “us,” or “Company”) and as an affiliate (“you” or “Affiliate”) who refers customers to purchase products or services from the Company.

By participating in the Program, you agree to use the Program in the manner specified in, and be bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your registration.

2. Affiliate Links

  1. Affiliate links are automatically generated, but you can also generate links for specific products or collections. If a customer clicks another affiliate’s link and later clicks yours, the most recent click (your link) will be credited.
  2. You may advertise ERGO PURRCH® products on online channels (Facebook, Instagram, etc.) provided you comply with Section 8 (Prohibited Activities).

3. Commissions and Payment

  • Commissions are calculated based on the net product total (the product subtotal after any discounts, excluding shipping charges, taxes, and returns).
  • The standard commission rate is 10% per qualifying order.
  • Commissions are calculated monthly, and payouts are issued at the end of each month in CAD.
  • A minimum of 3 qualifying orders must be reached before commissions are paid. If the threshold is not met, earnings will roll over to the following month and be paid once the threshold is reached.
  • Affiliates must provide accurate payment details in their account settings.
  • Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Transactions that result in returns, chargebacks, or cancellations are not eligible for commission.

    Commission Adjustments:

    If an order attributed to you is returned, canceled, or results in a chargeback after the commission has been paid, we reserve the right to deduct the corresponding commission from your future commissions.

If future commissions are insufficient to cover the deduction within 30 days, you agree to reimburse us the full amount of the overpaid commission within 15 days of written notice.


Blackout Dates:

At this time, we do not plan to limit or restrict affiliate commissions during major holidays. If this ever changes, it would most likely be in connection with specific promotional pricing offered around major sales events, and we will always notify affiliates in advance. Currently, the only planned large-scale sales period is Black Friday through Christmas.

Affiliate commissions may not apply during Company-designated promotional events or exceptional discount periods, including but not limited to Black Friday, Cyber Monday, or other large-scale sales. Any such blackout dates will be clearly communicated ahead of time, and sales made during those periods may not be eligible for commission.


4. Marketing Tools

We may provide promotional materials such as banners, logos, product images, or promotional messaging. You may use these assets only as directed and may not modify them without written approval from the Company.

5. Cookie Tracking

  1. We use cookies to track customers who click on your affiliate link. Customers must allow cookies for tracking to function.
  2. If a customer clears or disables cookies, we cannot track their activity and cannot pay commissions on those sales.
  3. The cookie duration will be disclosed during affiliate registration, and commissions will be applied to all qualifying purchases made during that period without the customer needing to click the affiliate link again.

6. Prohibited Activities

  • You may not misrepresent ERGO PURRCH® products or make unsubstantiated claims.

  • You may not bid on Company brand terms, trademarks, or domain names in any form of paid advertising.

  • You may not create or operate websites, social media accounts, or advertising campaigns that impersonate the Company or mislead customers.

  • You may not engage in spam, unsolicited commercial email, or any illegal marketing practices.

  • Affiliate-provided discount codes or referral codes may only be promoted directly on your own social media channels and personal website. Posting or distributing these codes on third-party coupon sites, deal forums, or any external sources outside your owned platforms is strictly prohibited. If such activity is identified, we reserve the right, without prior notice, to suspend or permanently disable your participation in the affiliate program.

    You may not submit, publish, or promote content (UGC) that violates our Affiliate UGC Policy, including but not limited to:

  • Unsafe or misleading depictions of cats or people.

  • Association with competitor brands or unrelated third-party promotions.

  • Edits or overlays that distort the actual look, design, or function of ERGO PURRCH® products.

    Any content that conflicts with the Company’s premium brand identity, which emphasizes:

  • Clean, uncluttered, and well-lit visuals that reflect modern, design-conscious living spaces.

  • Natural, sustainable, and pet-friendly context that supports our eco-conscious values.

  • Professional presentation that avoids low-quality imagery, distracting graphics, or inconsistent color palettes.

Any violation of these prohibitions may result in the immediate termination of your account and forfeiture of any unpaid commissions.

7. Removal from the Affiliate Program

You may request removal from the Affiliate Program at any time by contacting support@ergopurrch.com
We reserve the right to terminate your participation at our discretion, with or without cause. Where practicable, we will provide advance notice prior to termination.

8. Limitation of Liability

We will not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your participation in the Affiliate Program. Our total liability to you will not exceed the total commissions paid or payable to you under these Terms and Conditions.

9. Changes to Terms

We may modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Updated Terms and Conditions will be posted on this page, and your continued participation constitutes acceptance of those changes.

10. Governing Law

These Terms and Conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Ontario, Canada, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.


11. Product Access

Participation in the Affiliate Program does not include free products or samples. Affiliates are not entitled to receive a complimentary ERGO PURRCH® simply by registering for or participating in the Program. Any product gifting is at the sole discretion of the Company and is not guaranteed.

Go forward and refer!
We’re thrilled to have you as part of the ERGO PURRCH® Affiliate Program and wish you success.

If you have any questions, please email support@ergopurrch.com
